description: A small cluster of chunky toy blocks sits on a bed, including a long blue base piece with white, yellow, red, and green blocks attached. The left hand steadies the build while the right hand pulls the green block off to the right, then lifts the yellow block away and nudges the red piece loose; after that, both hands separate the long blue base from the white block, and the right hand slides the blue base further right, leaving the pieces spread out.
